## Overview `_align_hybrid_block_size` estimates the MLA page from `head_size`. Packed ds_mla caches store a different number of bytes per token (`fp8_ds_mla` 656, `nvfp4_ds_mla` 352), so the hybrid block size is computed for the wrong page. This is the second of two complementary PRs, stacked on #60967; only the top commit is new. #60967 stops padding Mamba pages for block-outermost layouts and changes plain fp8/bf16 MLA configurations; this PR corrects the block size for packed ds_mla configurations. Without #60967, the corrected size makes the KDA layers need a fourth group with MTP off: 80 of 384 configurations would be worse instead of 42. ## Claims - The hybrid alignment reads the packed width from `get_mla_state_content_bytes`, the lookup `MLAAttention.get_kv_cache_spec` already used inline. - With #60967, GLM-5.3-Flash `fp8_ds_mla` at 8k–128k: median +10.7% max concurrency vs main, worse in 42 of 384 configurations (down to −8.3%). ## Validation GLM-5.3-Flash (real `config.json`), same CPU allocation harness as #60967, 384 reachable `fp8_ds_mla` configurations. #60967 leaves all of them identical to main, so these numbers hold against both: 340 better, 2 equal, 42 worse (−8.3% to +26.1%). The worse ones, TP8 with MTP at ≥ 32k and SM90 TP4 at 128k, keep their group count; the smaller block rounds up to a worse multiple of the packed block-stride alignment.
Max concurrency vs #60967 (ad40bbf309 → 2dc9418eb5, main 35e920d671), 8 GiB KV cache per GPU, 8k / 32k / 128k SM90 `--kv-cache-dtype fp8_ds_mla`, prefix caching on: | TP | MTP off | MTP 1 | MTP 3 | MTP 5 | |---:|---|---|---|---| | 1 | +14.1 / +16.1 / +7.8 | +18.4 / +19.8 / +11.5 | +20.7 / +21.4 / +13.4 | +21.6 / +22.1 / +14.8 | | 2 | +16.6 / +13.7 / +3.6 | +16.2 / +13.2 / +6.9 | +23.0 / +19.9 / +10.7 | +18.3 / +15.7 / +8.9 | | 4 | +12.1 / +4.1 / −4.1 | +11.7 / +7.2 / +0.6 | +22.1 / +14.0 / +4.1 | +23.1 / +15.8 / +5.5 | | 8 | +26.1 / +16.3 / +10.7 | +6.6 / −2.0 / −7.4 | +8.7 / +0.0 / −6.5 | +10.1 / +1.7 / −5.7 | SM120 `--kv-cache-dtype auto` (→ `fp8_ds_mla`), prefix caching on: | TP | MTP off | MTP 1 | MTP 3 | MTP 5 | |---:|---|---|---|---| | 1 | +15.8 / +17.9 / +9.5 | +15.3 / +16.7 / +11.9 | +22.8 / +23.6 / +15.4 | +21.6 / +22.1 / +14.8 | | 2 | +16.6 / +13.7 / +3.6 | +10.7 / +7.8 / +3.9 | +21.4 / +18.4 / +9.0 | +22.6 / +19.9 / +10.7 | | 4 | +21.6 / +12.3 / +3.9 | +20.3 / +11.5 / +2.5 | +22.1 / +14.0 / +4.1 | +23.1 / +15.8 / +5.5 | | 8 | +25.9 / +14.2 / +9.1 | +8.8 / −1.0 / −6.1 | +10.0 / +0.8 / −5.2 | +10.7 / +2.2 / −4.5 | Prefix caching off and 40 GiB: same pattern. At 256k / 512k / 1M the median is +2.0% / +0.8% / −0.3%.
```bash pytest tests/v1/core/test_kv_cache_utils.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner.py -k "glm5_like_hybrid or hybrid_mla_block_alignment" ``` `test_hybrid_mla_block_alignment` fails on #60967 (block 4352 instead of 3328) and passes here. Not run on a GPU. ## Details - Among hybrid models, only GLM-5.3-Flash can select a ds_mla cache, and only `fp8_ds_mla`. - #60321 adds `mxfp4_mla` with its own inline width in both places; whichever PR lands second moves it into `get_mla_state_content_bytes`.
